data.description: Fully Furnished Premium Office | Business Bay
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this premium fully furnished office for sale in B2B Tower, Business Bay.

Spanning 574.69 sq. ft., this well-appointed office offers a modern and functional workspace in one of Dubai's leading business districts. Featuring a professional layout, high-quality furnishings, and contemporary finishes, it is an ideal choice for business owners, investors, or companies seeking a prestigious commercial address.

The office is ready to move in, allowing you to start operations immediately while benefiting from the excellent connectivity and vibrant business environment that Business Bay has to offer.

Property Details:

• Fully Furnished Office
• Size: 574.69 Sq. Ft.
• Premium Office Space
• Ready to Move In
• Bright and Functional Layout
• High-Quality Finishes
• Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
• Pantry Area
• Dedicated Parking Space
• Ideal for End Users and Investors

Building Amenities:

• 24/7 Security
• High-Speed Elevators
• Reception and Lobby Area
• Covered Parking
• Visitor Parking
• CCTV Monitoring
• Well-Maintained Common Areas

Location Highlights:

• Prime Business Bay Location
• Easy Access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road
• Minutes from Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa
• Close to Dubai Mall and DIFC
• Surrounded by Restaurants, Cafés, Banks, and Retail Outlets
• Excellent Public Transport Connectivity

B2B Tower offers businesses a prestigious corporate environment with excellent accessibility and modern facilities, making it an outstanding choice for both owner-occupiers and investors looking for long-term value.
